subject: physiology
title: Cerebellum and basal ganglia function

steps.tx: **Cerebellum** (**vermis** trunk gait rules, **hemispheres** limbs coordinate, **Purkinje** sole inhibitory outputs, **climbing** errors teach, **mossy** contexts carry, **ataxia** wide-based falls, **intention** tremor overshoots, **nystagmus** gaze evoked) with **tests** (**finger-nose** past points, **heel-shin** slides wobble, **dysdiadochokinesia** rapid alternating fails, **Romberg** proprioception splits) staggers; **alcohol** (anterior vermis shrinks) stoops. Purkinjes inhibit.
steps.say: Trunks limbs inhibits teaches carries is cerebellum: fingers overshoot heels slide rapid fails Rombergs split alcohols shrink gaits widen. Walks stagger.

vis.alt: Circuit of the cerebellar cortex: cortex through pontine nuclei sends mossy fibres to granule cells, parallel fibres excite Purkinje cells; climbing fibres from the inferior olive also excite Purkinje cells; Purkinje cells inhibit deep cerebellar nuclei, the only output.
vis.caption: Purkinje cells are the sole cortical output and are inhibitory; mossy fibres carry context, climbing fibres carry errors.

steps.tx: **Basal** (**striatum** caudate putamen inputs, **direct** D1 go disinhibits, **indirect** D2 no-go brakes, **dopamine** nigra modulates, **GABA** all outputs hush, **thalamus** returns cortex, **hyperkinetic** too little brake dances, **hypokinetic** too much brake freezes) with **loops** (**motor** putamen acts, **associative** caudate plans, **limbic** accumbens rewards) gates; **DBS** (subthalamic wires) unlocks. Ganglia gate.
steps.say: Inputs gos brakes modulates hushes returns is basal: dances freeze wires unlock loops act plan reward. Brakes balance.

vis.alt: Wiring diagram of the basal ganglia. Cortex excites striatum. Direct pathway: striatum D1 inhibits GPi, which frees the thalamus to excite cortex. Indirect pathway: striatum D2 inhibits GPe, which frees the subthalamic nucleus to excite GPi, which inhibits thalamus. Substantia nigra pars compacta dopamine excites D1 cells and inhibits D2 cells.
vis.caption: Direct pathway releases movement; indirect pathway brakes it; dopamine pushes toward movement.

steps.tx: **Parkinson** (**TRAP** tremor rigidity akinesia posture, **pill-rolling** rest asymmetric, **nigra** Lewy dies, **levodopa** gold wears off, **dyskinesia** peak-dose writhes, **freezing** doorways stick, **selegiline** MAO-B spares, **pramipexole** impulse gambles) with **mimics** (**PSP** vertical gaze falls, **MSA** autonomic stridor, **CBD** alien apraxia, **DLB** visual fluctuates) stiffens; **physio** (cueing dances) frees. Nigras fade.
steps.say: TRAPs pills Lewys levodopas dyskinesias freezes is Parkinson: gazes fall autonomics stridor aliens act visuals fluctuate cues free steps stick. Bodies slow.

vis.alt: Parkinson disease circuit: loss of substantia nigra dopamine weakens the direct pathway and releases the indirect pathway, so globus pallidus internus over-inhibits the thalamus, causing bradykinesia, rigidity and rest tremor.
vis.caption: TRAP: Tremor at rest, Rigidity, Akinesia, Postural instability; the cause is nigral dopamine loss.

steps.tx: **Chorea** (**Huntington** CAG anticipates psychiatric, **hemiballismus** subthalamic flings, **Sydenham** rheumatic girls, **Wilson** KF copper chelates, **tardive** dopamine blockers chew, **tetrabenazine** depletes chorea depresses, **genetics** predictive counsels, **juvenile** rigid Westphal) with **dystonia** (**torticollis** botulinum twists, **writer** task cramps) writhes; **tics** (Tourette suppressible) jerk. Dances writhe.
steps.say: CAGs flings rheumatics coppers chews depletes is chorea: twists cramp jerks suppress twists predict counsels juveniles stiffen genes expand. Bodies dance.

vis.alt: Table of hyperkinetic movement disorders by lesion: Huntington caudate and putamen with CAG repeat, hemiballismus contralateral subthalamic nucleus, Sydenham chorea after streptococcal infection, Wilson disease copper in basal ganglia, tardive dyskinesia from dopamine blockers.
vis.caption: Hemiballismus: subthalamic nucleus stroke. Huntington: caudate loss and CAG expansion.
